|translation='''Title:''' Walker Sighting.

'''Card text:'''
Use immediately after the opponent deploys or moves an AT-AT to a planet location. Search your Reserve Deck for up to three exterior locations of that planet and deploy them at once. Then shuffle, cut, and return the Reserve Deck to its place.

'''Lore:'''
"Echo station. 3TA. Imperial walker confirmed." The Rebels adopted a tactic of putting as much distance as possible between walkers and Rebel troops and preparing a defense.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses 惑星位置 and 屋外位置 for planet site and exterior sites, and says return the Reserve Deck to its place.
